claims.observation: Constructor-specific prose says N=V^T, reversing the class-level prose. Signature is Geom_OffsetCurve(C, Offset, V, isNotCheckC0=false).
Implementation computes theD1.XYZ().Crossed(myOffsetDir.XYZ()), normalizes it, multiplies by myOffset/R, and adds it to the basis point. This is explicitly T cross V with signed offset.

resolved_sign_for_pinned_jar_frame.basis_point: (r,0,z) in global XZ plane; parameter direction is base axis to mouth

runtime_caveats: This resolves the documented cross-order conflict using the official 7.9.3 implementation expression, not a test construction.
The Geom_OffsetCurve docs warn that offset singularities are not checked at construction and that an offset may self-intersect; those remain later geometry gates.
The installed OCP class introspection is a separate read-only check; no CAD constructor is called.
